expect.mustContribute: The restructured estimate: expected collisions per day ≈ Σ over tenants of (new IDs per day × live IDs)/2⁶⁴ = s²·(5×10⁶ · 4.5×10⁸)/2⁶⁴ for a tenant with share s. Biggest tenant (s = 0.08): ≈8×10⁻⁷ per day, ≈9×10⁻⁴ over three years. Across all tenants the total scales with Σs² (tenant concentration), bounded by 0.08, so at most ≈1% over three years and likely a few tenths of a percent with a realistic long tail. Orders of magnitude better than 56% but nowhere near 10⁻¹³; whether to drop the index turns on the cost of one collision, and 128-bit IDs make the question disappear.
expect.notes: Execution request from an expert: do the computation. An optional sharp addition is questioning 'harmless': if event IDs leak into webhooks, idempotency keys or customer exports, an archived-ID collision may not be harmless.
